caption: The quantitative relationships of Stable Diffusion during sampling. These figures show the relationship between the norm of the predicted score ϵθ (xt |c), ϵθ (xt ) and the distance norm between them during the 50 sampling timesteps of CFG. The guidance strength for the first two figures is set to 3, while the last two figures have a guidance strength of 80. The caption for all figures states, ”A photograph of an astronaut riding a horse.”
